approvalMessage.text:
APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 14 Chapter 486

      MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 2089-B, entitled:

    "AN  ACT to amend the education law, in relation to accurate report-
        ing of crimes on college and university campuses"

    APPROVED

  This bill would require all colleges and universities in New  York  to
notify  appropriate law enforcement of a violent felony or missing resi-
dent student within 24 hours.  This  legislation  strengthens  reporting
requirements for violent felonies and will lead to safer college campus-
es.

  However,  there  is  one  critical  exception  to  this  new reporting
requirement. Existing  federal  law  explicitly  requires  colleges  and
universities to give sexual assault victims the option to decide whether
to  report  the crime to law enforcement, and this legislation would not
alter this right. The Legislature has agreed to pass  additional  legis-
lation making clear that sexual assault victims will retain the right to
choose whether to report a crime to law enforcement. On that basis, I am
signing this bill.

  The bill is approved.                       (signed) ANDREW M. CUOMO

                                ______
